title: SwitchCamBoat
description: Quickly switch camera perspective while ice boat racing.
body:
# SwitchCamBoat

**Switch your camera perspective while racing with boats.**

Hold the keybind to switch perspective, and release it to instantly return to your previous view. This provides a fast and seamless way to adjust your camera mid-race.

*Originally created by imStormyz for the BoatLabs Minecraft server.*
